gen-gf-unkempt-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans handles the text in a level, unfussy way, its e opening wide at the terminal. Unkempt supplies the swagger above it, and that loud-meets-quiet split is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-rethink-sans: Rethink Sans keeps its openings generous at every weight, which gives the text a friendly, current feel. And Unkempt, expressive and a bit bossy up top, makes the difference between the two the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-roboto-flex: Roboto Flex reads approachable and modern, with a wide slot between the two ends of its c. Unkempt keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, while the body is low in contrast, so the two sit together without fighting.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-rosario: Laser-cut and loud, Unkempt looks like it was sliced from sheet with a single cutting width. Rosario follows in a contemporary, friendly voice, its c endings never curling inward, so the headline gets the stage and the text stays out of its way.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ruluko: Unkempt hums along at a flat, constant line weight that makes it instantly recognizable. It is the one for attitude, while Ruluko, with broad open counters on c and s, is the one for easy reading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sansation: Unkempt has zero stroke modulation, every line the same throughout. Sansation, approachable and low in contrast, follows with no ink pooling where its curves turn in, so the loud heading and tidy body feel like a deliberate pairing.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sarabun: Cut like an engraver's single pass, Unkempt arrives with real presence. Sarabun then carries the text with a wide channel into every bowl, so a longer passage should read clean and approachable.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sarala: Sarala is approachable and contemporary, with distinct gaps in c, e and s and a stroke like neon glass tubing. Sarala under a headline in Unkempt works well when the text is given a little more size than usual.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Sawarabi Gothic opens a jaw on every curved stroke, giving it a contemporary, level feel. Sawarabi Gothic would carry a longer passage smoothly, its low-contrast line gliding under the eye much as Unkempt's wire-like strokes do.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-shanti: Unkempt looks built from rods rather than carved blades, expressive and commanding at the top. But Shanti, modern and professional with a generous entry into the e's eye, quietly takes over below, and that split is the pair's strongest quality.
